title: SAVE10 current core and C6 course transaction projection
$comment: DB10 has 19 stores. This projection contains 11 core stores plus courseActivities/courseDrafts; existing six specialized stores retain their separate contracts. UTF-8 byte quotas, generation, CAS, ownership, proofs, keys and cross-row relations are enforced at the transaction boundary, not by this structural schema.

blob.$comment: Native Blob only. No JSON object/string/null can represent it; validate actual Blob using runtime assertRecord and its byte/format/size relationships.
